Solid arrow: data flow. Dashed: optional or read-only. Colours: grey-blue inputs, green ingestion and UI, amber models, purple signal core, pink side-cars, red stress, blue API.
Storage: no SQL database; files (JSON, JSONL, NPZ, joblib) and in-memory repositories behind Protocols (ports.py).
All trained models are experimental; the portfolio is synthetic; scenario shocks are assumptions. Plainer views: docs/architecture.png and docs/architecture_simple.png.
